_readme: Frozen scoring eval set. Each case is a real posting as it was scored (many were title-only backfills — descriptions reflect that), the correct band per owner feedback, and the reason. Every feedback.md rule that changes scoring must ship a case here (enforced by eval_runner's count check). Pass = exact band; adjacent band = warn; >=2 bands off, or any top/misfit confusion = fail.
